title: Google Sign-in
summary: Registers Google into the kernel sign-in shell. The GIS client id lives on this plugin, not kernel JSON.

blocks.title: Sign-in shell stays in the kernel
blocks.text: Session, OTP, unlock, and the HTTP routes stay kernel. This plugin owns provider credentials (settingsSchema / secrets). Disable the plugin to hide this method even if shop Preferences still list it.
Configure at Admin → Plugins → Google Sign-in. Kernel identity reads via getCachedPluginSettings / getCachedPluginSecret using plugin id tuucho-signin-google.

Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-signin-google/ (public config.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

items.description: string — public. OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud (….apps.googleusercontent.com). Required before Google Sign-in appears on the shop.
string — public. How long a first-time Google signup token stays valid (for example 10m). Raise only if customers need longer to finish.
